prompt: How many countries were part of the commonwealth on the date Prince Charles ascended?
answer:
**56 countries** were members of the Commonwealth when Prince Charles became King Charles III on **8 September 2022**.  

He became **Head of the Commonwealth** and monarch of **14 Commonwealth realms** (in addition to the United Kingdom); the other 42 member countries are independent republics or have their own monarchs.
